newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Danish May WPI unchanged at 1.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Danish May WPI unchanged at 1.6 pct.

text.p: Danish wholesale prices for May are expected to show a year-on-year rise of 1.6 percent, unchanged from April, according to a Reuter consensus survey.
The panel of four analysts saw a month-on-month rise of 0.6 percent, compared with a 0.9 percent rise between March and April.
The May Wholesale Price Index is to be published by the National Statistics Office at 0730 GMT on Wednesday. --Stig Pedersen, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
